These are design and simulation studies; no plant provides resilience today
The burner's modeled availability (0.86-0.995) is below hyperscale Tier III (0.99982)
Resilience also depends on grid design, storage, and planning beyond any single source

So resilience is a role fusion is aimed at, under stated constraints, not one it fills now. Today's resilience must come from today's technologies. Fusion's contribution is a future one, described plainly. See grid resilience and why firm power matters.

title: Serving Defense and Civilian Needs
lede: The burner's two housings serve fixed defense installations (Aegis) and data centers (MetroVolt); both are clean-power roles, stated plainly.
body: The burner (Aegis / MetroVolt) is a single D-3He tandem-mirror design studied in two housings for two kinds of user. Aegis is for fixed defense installations — resilient, on-site clean power for bases and critical facilities. MetroVolt is for data centers, which need dense, steady power close to load. Both are about supplying clean firm power where it is hard to supply otherwise.

We are precise about Aegis: it is fixed installations, not naval, and its purpose is clean resilient generation, not weaponry. Naming the defense application honestly is part of candor; obscuring it would not be. Clean power for defense infrastructure is a legitimate civilian-adjacent need, and we treat it as such.

<svg viewBox='0 0 440 210' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' role='img' aria-label='Energy underpins human development'><rect x='24' y='150' width='90' height='40' rx='5' fill='#232C39'/><text x='69' y='175' fill='#D4AD5C' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Energy</text><rect x='140' y='150' width='96' height='40' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='188' y='175' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Water, food</text><rect x='262' y='150' width='96' height='40' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='310' y='175' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Health, work</text><line x1='114' y1='170' x2='140' y2='170' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='236' y1='170' x2='262' y2='170' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='2'/><text x='230' y='40' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle'>Access compounds upward</text><path d='M60 120 L220 60 L380 40' fill='none' stroke='#D4AD5C' stroke-width='2.5'/><circle cx='60' cy='120' r='4' fill='#232C39'/><circle cx='220' cy='60' r='4' fill='#232C39'/><circle cx='380' cy='40' r='4' fill='#232C39'/></svg>
The same gates apply to both housings
Plug coils overstressed ~3 to 3.9x at the design bore
Operating regime 166 to 830x beyond any existing device
Helium-3 demand ~400x domestic supply per commercial unit

These are physics findings that hold regardless of housing, and we do not soften them for either user. The burner is a design and simulation study. Serving both defense and civilian needs means serving both with the same honesty. See defense installations and data centers.

title: The Honest Promise
lede: What Kronos actually promises is narrow and keepable: rigorous work, open data, stated limits — not a guaranteed clean-energy future.
body: Grand promises about fusion have a long history of not being kept, and each broken one erodes trust in the field. So we keep our promise narrow enough to honor. We do not promise cheap limitless power by a date. We promise rigorous design and simulation, open publication, honest gates, and predictions that can be checked.

This is deliberately less exciting than the usual pitch, and more durable. A narrow promise kept builds the credibility that a broad promise broken destroys. It is also the only kind of promise honest to make about machines that are still design and simulation studies with FOAK first tritium targeted around 2030.

<svg viewBox='0 0 440 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' role='img' aria-label='Balancing promise and candor'><line x1='220' y1='30' x2='220' y2='150' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='3'/><line x1='110' y1='60' x2='330' y2='60' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='3'/><line x1='110' y1='60' x2='90' y2='110' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><line x1='110' y1='60' x2='150' y2='110' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><line x1='330' y1='60' x2='310' y2='110' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><line x1='330' y1='60' x2='350' y2='110' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><rect x='80' y='110' width='120' height='26' rx='5' fill='#232C39'/><text x='140' y='128' fill='#D4AD5C' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Aspiration</text><rect x='290' y='110' width='120' height='26' rx='5' fill='#232C39'/><text x='350' y='128' fill='#D4AD5C' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Candor</text><rect x='190' y='150' width='60' height='16' rx='3' fill='#232C39'/></svg>
Publish the design, data, and code openly, with permanent identifiers
State the honest gates plainly, including the four burner gates
Make no hardware net-gain claim before FOAK
Pre-register falsifiable predictions and report results either way

If fusion earns its place, these commitments are how it will have earned it — in public, checkably, without inflation. The promise is not a clean-energy future delivered; it is honest work done in the open toward one. See humanity's dream and humility in a grand mission.

title: Designing for the Commons
lede: Treating fusion knowledge as a shared commons — published, licensed openly, reproducible — is how the work serves more than one company.
body: A technology meant to serve humanity should not lock its foundational knowledge behind closed doors. Kronos treats its physics results, data, and methods as a commons: published openly, deposited with permanent identifiers (Zenodo DOIs), and released under open licenses so others can inspect, reuse, and challenge them. This is a design choice about who the work is for.

The reasoning is practical as well as ethical. Fusion is too large a problem for any one team. Open results let independent groups check our claims, reuse our methods, and advance the field faster than any single company could alone. The commons is how the mission outruns the company.

<svg viewBox='0 0 460 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' role='img' aria-label='Open-science flywheel serving people'><circle cx='230' cy='110' r='78' fill='none' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='230' cy='32' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><circle cx='308' cy='110' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><circle cx='230' cy='188' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><circle cx='152' cy='110' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><text x='230' y='20' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Publish openly</text><text x='398' y='114' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Invite refutation</text><text x='230' y='208' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Correct the design</text><text x='72' y='114' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Earn trust</text><text x='230' y='116' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='13' text-anchor='middle'>People benefit</text></svg>
What we place in the commons
Published papers describing the frozen designs and their limits
Open data and code that reproduce the key results
Pre-registered predictions that anyone can later judge
Clearly documented honest gates and open questions

We keep economics out of the commons account deliberately; the shared thing is knowledge, not a sales case. Designing for the commons means the benefit of a correct result reaches everyone, and the cost of a wrong one is caught early by many eyes. See open science as a gift and why we publish openly.

title: Open Science as a Gift to Humanity
lede: Publishing openly is a form of giving: the work's value spreads beyond those who paid to produce it.
body: The economics-free case for giving knowledge away

When a result is published openly, its usefulness is not consumed by the giver. A hundred teams can build on the same open dataset without diminishing it. In that specific sense, open science is a gift that costs the giver little to share and can benefit many — one of the few things where generosity and progress fully align.

Kronos publishes its fusion physics openly for this reason. The breeder and burner design studies, their data, and their methods are placed where others can use them. We do not treat the foundational science as a moat, because the mission is not served by hoarding what could help the whole field advance.

<svg viewBox='0 0 460 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' role='img' aria-label='Open-science flywheel serving people'><circle cx='230' cy='110' r='78' fill='none' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='230' cy='32' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><circle cx='308' cy='110' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><circle cx='230' cy='188' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><circle cx='152' cy='110' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><text x='230' y='20' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Publish openly</text><text x='398' y='114' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Invite refutation</text><text x='230' y='208' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Correct the design</text><text x='72' y='114' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Earn trust</text><text x='230' y='116' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='13' text-anchor='middle'>People benefit</text></svg>
What makes it a real gift
Permanent identifiers so the record does not disappear
Open licenses so reuse is legally clear, not merely tolerated
Reproducibility so the gift actually works in others' hands
Honest limits, so recipients are not misled by what they receive

A gift of knowledge is only real if the recipient can use it and trust it. That is why openness and honesty travel together in this mission: an open but inflated record would be a poisoned gift. See why we publish openly and designing for the commons.

title: Why We Publish Openly
lede: Open publication is both a service to the field and a discipline on ourselves — it invites the scrutiny that keeps claims honest.
body: Publishing openly serves others, and it disciplines us. It serves others by making methods and data reusable. It disciplines us because anything published openly can be checked, and knowing that a result will face scrutiny changes how carefully it is made. Openness is not only generosity; it is a commitment to being caught if we are wrong.

This is why open publication belongs in a mission about building for humanity. A closed program can drift into believing its own optimistic figures. An open one is held to account by anyone willing to reproduce the work. The scrutiny is the point, not a side effect.

<svg viewBox='0 0 460 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' role='img' aria-label='Open-science flywheel serving people'><circle cx='230' cy='110' r='78' fill='none' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='230' cy='32' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><circle cx='308' cy='110' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><circle cx='230' cy='188' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><circle cx='152' cy='110' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><text x='230' y='20' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Publish openly</text><text x='398' y='114' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Invite refutation</text><text x='230' y='208' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Correct the design</text><text x='72' y='114' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Earn trust</text><text x='230' y='116' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='13' text-anchor='middle'>People benefit</text></svg>
Published gates cannot be walked back without notice
Open data lets independent readers rerun the analysis
Pre-registered predictions expose us to being proven wrong
Permanent records make the timeline of claims auditable

The result is a body of work meant to be trusted because it can be tested, not because it is asserted confidently. For a technology as consequential as fusion, that is the only trust worth having. See open science as a gift and inviting refutation.

title: The Shared-Knowledge Flywheel
lede: Publish, invite refutation, correct the design, earn trust — a loop in which each turn makes the work more useful to people.
body: Open science is not a single act but a cycle. A result is published; others try to refute or reproduce it; the design is corrected where they succeed; trust accrues where it survives; and the improved, trusted result is published again. Each turn of this loop leaves the work more useful and more credible than the last.

<svg viewBox='0 0 460 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' role='img' aria-label='Open-science flywheel serving people'><circle cx='230' cy='110' r='78' fill='none' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='230' cy='32' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><circle cx='308' cy='110' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><circle cx='230' cy='188' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><circle cx='152' cy='110' r='7' fill='#D4AD5C'/><text x='230' y='20' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Publish openly</text><text x='398' y='114' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Invite refutation</text><text x='230' y='208' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Correct the design</text><text x='72' y='114' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Earn trust</text><text x='230' y='116' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='13' text-anchor='middle'>People benefit</text></svg>

The flywheel matters to a humanity-facing mission because it is how honest progress actually happens in a field this hard. No single team can get fusion right in one pass. The loop distributes the checking across many minds and compounds partial results into a durable base others can rely on.
Publish openly — data, code, and the frozen design
Correct the design — including publishing negative results
Earn trust — so the next result is believed on evidence, not assertion

Crucially, the flywheel only turns if we are willing to be wrong in public. A loop that only ever confirms itself is not science; it is marketing. The willingness to publish a failed prediction is what keeps the wheel honest. See publishing negative results and the open-science flywheel.

title: Humility in a Grand Mission
lede: A mission this large is a temptation to grandiosity; humility is the discipline that keeps it honest and worth trusting.
body: Talking about powering humanity and healing the planet invites grandiosity. The larger the mission, the easier it is to slip from what is true into what is inspiring, and to mistake the second for the first. Humility is the deliberate corrective: holding the aspiration while refusing to let it inflate the claims.

Concretely, humility means saying that both machines are design and simulation studies, that the burner has four hard gates we cannot yet clear, that the breeder's tritium self-sufficiency is an open question treated as a design lever, and that we make no net-gain claim before FOAK. None of these admissions diminishes the mission; they make it believable.

<svg viewBox='0 0 440 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' role='img' aria-label='Balancing promise and candor'><line x1='220' y1='30' x2='220' y2='150' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='3'/><line x1='110' y1='60' x2='330' y2='60' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='3'/><line x1='110' y1='60' x2='90' y2='110' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><line x1='110' y1='60' x2='150' y2='110' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><line x1='330' y1='60' x2='310' y2='110' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><line x1='330' y1='60' x2='350' y2='110' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><rect x='80' y='110' width='120' height='26' rx='5' fill='#232C39'/><text x='140' y='128' fill='#D4AD5C' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Aspiration</text><rect x='290' y='110' width='120' height='26' rx='5' fill='#232C39'/><text x='350' y='128' fill='#D4AD5C' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Candor</text><rect x='190' y='150' width='60' height='16' rx='3' fill='#232C39'/></svg>
What humility looks like in practice
State limits before benefits when both are true
Prefer 'if the physics closes' to 'when we deliver'
Credit other clean technologies rather than claiming primacy
Let open data and predictions, not confident language, carry the weight

Humility is not the opposite of ambition; it is ambition disciplined by evidence. The dream of fusion deserves to be pursued, and it deserves not to be oversold. See the honest promise and what we will not claim.

title: From Scarcity to Stewardship
lede: The move from fighting over scarce fuel to stewarding an abundant one changes the human relationship with energy.
body: For most of history, energy has meant scarcity — deposits to find, control, and defend. Abundant, widely available fuel would shift the frame from scarcity toward stewardship: the question becomes not who controls the fuel but how well we manage the systems that use it. That is a healthier relationship, though not an automatic one.

Fusion fuels point in this direction. Deuterium is in seawater, tritium can be bred, and the reaction burns nothing. The scarce exception is the burner's helium-3, which is exactly why breeding and, distantly, lunar sources are discussed honestly rather than assumed. Even the abundance story has a scarce chapter we do not hide.

<svg viewBox='0 0 460 150' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' role='img' aria-label='Fuel abundance chain'><rect x='16' y='55' width='110' height='40' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='71' y='72' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Deuterium</text><text x='71' y='88' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='10' text-anchor='middle'>from seawater</text><rect x='175' y='55' width='110' height='40' rx='6' fill='#232C39'/><text x='230' y='72' fill='#D4AD5C' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Fusion reaction</text><text x='230' y='88' fill='#D4AD5C' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='10' text-anchor='middle'>design study</text><rect x='334' y='55' width='110' height='40' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='389' y='72' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Heat / isotopes</text><text x='389' y='88' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='10' text-anchor='middle'>for people</text><line x1='126' y1='75' x2='175' y2='75' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='285' y1='75' x2='334' y2='75' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='2'/></svg>
Stewardship is a choice, not a guarantee
Abundant fuel removes one driver of conflict, not all of them
Stewardship of clean systems still requires care in materials and waste
The machines are design and simulation studies; abundance is potential, not delivered

Stewardship is the mindset a post-scarcity energy source would invite, and the one we try to practice now in how we handle materials, data, and claims. See from extraction to stewardship and letting the planet heal.

title: What Abundance Actually Means
lede: Energy 'abundance' is easy to romanticize; here is the precise, bounded meaning we stand behind.
body: 'Energy abundance' can mean anything from a fair aspiration to an empty slogan. We fix its meaning narrowly. Abundance here refers to fuel that is widely available and a reaction that releases large energy without combustion — not free energy, not unlimited energy, and not energy without engineering constraints.
Fuel not confined to scarce, contested geographic deposits
Very high energy per unit fuel mass, by the physics of fusing light nuclei
No carbon combustion, so cleaner output at the point of generation
Byproducts — neutrons, tritium, helium-3 — that are useful rather than only waste
Not free: building and running plants is demanding (details kept out of this account)
Not unlimited: real plants have real output limits
Not proven: both machines are design and simulation studies
Not without a scarce input: the burner's helium-3 is a genuine supply gate (~400x domestic)

<svg viewBox='0 0 460 150' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' role='img' aria-label='Fuel abundance chain'><rect x='16' y='55' width='110' height='40' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='71' y='72' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Deuterium</text><text x='71' y='88' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='10' text-anchor='middle'>from seawater</text><rect x='175' y='55' width='110' height='40' rx='6' fill='#232C39'/><text x='230' y='72' fill='#D4AD5C' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Fusion reaction</text><text x='230' y='88' fill='#D4AD5C' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='10' text-anchor='middle'>design study</text><rect x='334' y='55' width='110' height='40' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='389' y='72' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle'>Heat / isotopes</text><text x='389' y='88' fill='#232C39' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='10' text-anchor='middle'>for people</text><line x1='126' y1='75' x2='175' y2='75' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='285' y1='75' x2='334' y2='75' stroke='#232C39' stroke-width='2'/></svg>

Held this precisely, abundance is a defensible claim about fuel and physics rather than a promise about outcomes. That precision is what lets the word survive contact with the honest gates. See abundance without combustion and fusion fuel and abundance.
